outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (NICU admission, meconium aspiration, ARDS, perinatal death, Apgar score <=7 at one minute)
cohort: A cohort of 159 women with term pregnancies complicated by isolated oligohydramnios (AFI <=5 cm) who belonged to Lower Middle and Upper Lower socioeconomic classes.
finding: No significant association was found between socioeconomic status (restricted to Lower Middle and Upper Lower classes) and composite adverse neonatal outcomes, although maternal comorbidity was a significant predictor of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No significant association was detected between socioeconomic status and mode of delivery (cesarean delivery).
